2608.27036.title: Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation
2608.27036.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. To train our model, we distill silver fragments and drafts from a large teacher model. Our experiments with the Qwen3 model family, over 6 languages, including up to 5 domains per language, demonstrate that fragment-based MT significantly outperforms alternative methods like standard k-shot or basic drafting.
2608.27036.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）可以被訓練以進行連鎖思考推理，以提高其回應的可靠性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們探討如何利用明確的推理來進行基於LLM的機器翻譯（MT），並使用上下文樣本。<lb/>我們引入了一種新穎的基於片段的推理框架，其中模型首先從檢索到的相似範例中提取平行的源-目標片段，並使用這些片段作為中間推理痕跡來生成最終翻譯。<lb/>為了訓練我們的模型，我們從大型教師模型中提煉出銀片段和草稿。<lb/>我們對Qwen3模型系列的實驗涵蓋了6種語言，包括每種語言最多5個領域，顯示基於片段的機器翻譯顯著優於標準k-shot或基本草擬等替代方法。
